Show date picker month and weekday names in the app locale (#4873)

* Show date picker month and weekday names in the app locale

The flatpickr calendar on date fields and date time filters always used English names. Take them from the browser Intl API through Luxon, using the locale on the html lang attribute, so no flatpickr locale files are bundled.

* Merge a picker_options locale over the generated names

A `locale` passed through `picker_options` replaced the whole generated
object, so the Monday-first route on date filters silently dropped the
localized names. Strip it out of the user options and spread it over
the generated names instead; the field controller still applies
`first_day_of_week` on top.

The helper now returns `{}` when Intl rejects the `<html lang>` value
(e.g. `en_US`), so the picker keeps flatpickr's English names instead
of initEdit aborting for every date field on the form.

The pt field spec asserts the first weekday is "seg." so the
Sunday-first rotation is covered, and the filter example reads its
translations from the dummy's avo.pt.yml instead of a runtime shim.
The avo-i18n skill gets a Gotchas bullet on dates and the picker.

---------

Co-authored-by: Paul Bob <paul.ionut.bob@gmail.com>

Use the model's attribute translations for field labels (#4869)

* Use the model's attribute translations for field labels

When a field has no translation_key and no avo field translation exists,
fall back to the model's human_attribute_name, but only when an actual
activerecord.attributes or attributes translation is present. Labels for
models without translations stay as they were.

* Rescue bad pluralization data in the model label lookup and add config.model_attribute_translations

A Hash under attributes.<id> (Rails' nested-attribute labels) made
human_attribute_name raise I18n::InvalidPluralizationData through
field.name, so every page rendering such a field 500'd. The lookup now
rescues it and falls back to the humanized id, like the Avo-key loop.

config.model_attribute_translations (default true) turns the model
lookup off so labels resolve exactly as before.

Specs cover the Hash fallback, the missing translation_key guard, the
flag, and one feature example rendering the label on the product form.
The avo-i18n, avo-update, avo-fields and avo-admin-config skills teach
the new cascade step and the flag.

---------

Co-authored-by: Paul Bob <paul.ionut.bob@gmail.com>

Let actions hide the confirm and cancel buttons (#4868)

* feat: let actions hide the confirm and cancel buttons

Adds hide_confirm_button and hide_cancel_button options to actions. Both
take a boolean or a block, like confirmation. When both are hidden the
modal skips its footer.

Fixes #4032

* docs: document hide_confirm_button and hide_cancel_button in the actions skill

* Disable Mod+Enter when the confirm button is hidden and pass record and query to the hide predicates

Hiding the Run button did not stop the modal's submit hotkey: findSubmitter found no button and
form.requestSubmit(undefined) still ran the action. The hotkey now returns when there is no submitter,
with a system spec that fails without the guard.

The hide_* predicates share one helper and pass record and query, as the skill and the API docs promise
for block options. The skill paragraph now says what the keys do: Mod+Enter stops submitting, Escape and
the header X still close. The redundant "renders both buttons by default" request example is dropped.

Support link_to_record on number and date fields (#4871)

* Support link_to_record on number and date fields

Number, date, date_time and time fields inherit link_to_record from
TextField, but their index components never rendered the link.

* Cover link_to_record with one system spec and update the fields skill

One Playground system spec replaces the feature spec and the comment
system spec: it asserts all four cells link to the record after the
date-field controller has rewritten the text, clicks the date_time link,
and checks none of the cells link without the option.

The avo-fields skill now lists every field that honors link_to_record.

The three date index templates pass tag.div straight to link_to_if
instead of capturing the content_tag block first.

* Take the field options as a positional hash so CI's rubocop does not flag forwarding

---------

Co-authored-by: Paul Bob <paul.ionut.bob@gmail.com>

Fetch tag suggestions again after a value is selected in select mode (#4872)

* Fetch tag suggestions again after a value is selected in select mode

In select mode the selected value is a tag, so typing over it edits that
tag and Tagify fires edit:input instead of input. The tags controller only
listened for input, so fetch_values_from stopped being called until the
value was cleared. Listen for edit:input too and reuse the same fetch.

Part of #3317

* Create Alice after the select so the suggestion assertion needs the refetch

The dummy get_users endpoint ignores q, so Alice was already in the whitelist from the Bob fetch and the final assertion passed without the fix. Creating her after the selection makes the dropdown list her only through the refetch.
